title: Sampling Preferences Yields Simple Trustworthiness Scores

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to standardized and customized stereotype system and user prompts across various demographic groups, utilizing the DecodingTrust benchmark.

Measuring base rate parity and assessing performance on test data containing different sensitive attributes across zero-shot and few-shot settings, relying on metrics from the TrustLLM and DecodingTrust frameworks.
